description: The file 'fsmonitor.h' defines inline functions for managing the state of the filesystem monitor within a version control system (likely Git). It includes functions to check if the filesystem monitor has been refreshed, to mark cache entries as valid, and to invalidate them, with considerations for submodules and tracking changes.

methods.name: int is_fsmonitor_refreshed(const struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Checks if the filesystem monitor has been refreshed at least once or if it is disabled.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as valid for the filesystem monitor, if applicable, unless it's a submodule.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry's filesystem monitor validity and triggers untracked cache invalidation.

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_invalid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_valid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/
